purpose: Independent historical-language validation of named-place recognition after the synthetic SH2026 benchmark was frozen.

derived_dataset.freeze_note: The source list and deterministic passage-selection rule were fixed before model execution. This checksum was recorded after the first successful deterministic construction and is now a release invariant; model errors did not alter the selected files or passages.

upstream.reference: Rayson et al. (2017), A deeply annotated testbed for geographical text analysis: The Corpus of Lake District Writing

selection_policy.design: purposive chronological spread within the existing 28-text CLDW gold-standard subcorpus
selection_policy.passage_rule: For each fixed source file, select the first paragraph containing at least two gold <cdplace> annotations and 80-1200 normalized plain-text characters. If none exists, select the first paragraph containing at least one gold <cdplace> annotation in that length range.
selection_policy.evaluation_scope: TOPONYM recognition only. This external check does not claim to validate the richer synthetic ontology, journey extraction, affect, or interpretation layers.
selection_policy.rationale: The aim is a source-derived generalization check on historical prose/poetry, not a second tunable development set.
